title: Three Ban Sheng Puppets
summary: Left as bait by the Hun Clan, the Flower Sect, the Gu Clan and Xiao Yan's group are trapped by a second beast tide in the canyon. Yun Yun's Flower Sect holds a formation with help from Gu Clan disciples while Xiao Yan hands out Dou Qi pills. Xiao Yan and Gu Qing Yang blast a path along the cliff with the Open Mountain Seal and follow the trail of the Hun Clan and the Heaven Demon Phoenix Tribe. Hun Yu seals the tunnel behind him to bury them with the beasts, but they break through and reach the Bodhisattva Ancient Tree. Three Ban Sheng puppets guard it, one of them a lost Hun Clan ancestor. Qing Lin senses a cold, gray qi of negative emotion in the tree. Xiao Yan proposes that all sides fight the puppets together, and Hun Yu and Jiu Feng agree.
